title: Home Assistant Companion for Wear OS

components.caption: State-hoisted Wear landing destination with favorites, area navigation, domain navigation, and settings in light and dark themes.
Large-round Wear destination with mixed on/off entities.
Large-round Wear sensor overview destination.
Large-round light detail destination with brightness state.
Large-round shortcut tile selection destination.
Large-round selected shortcut ordering destination.
Large-round camera tile selection destination.
Large-round template tile configuration destination.
Large-round refresh interval picker destination.
Large-round camera tile settings with a selected entity and refresh interval.
Large-round sensor manager destination with header and toggle rows.
State-hoisted expandable favorite selector in light and dark themes.
Large-round favorites and visibility settings destination.
Large-round complication configuration destination.

redlines.label: Install Home Assistant on your phone to continue

components.caption: Large-round prompt to install Home Assistant on the paired phone.
Wrap-content Assist request and response bubble components.
Wrap-content entity toggle and action row components.
Large-round entity selection chip with icon and friendly name.
Large-round switch and checkbox controls in checked and unchecked states.
Wrap-content enabled, charging, and default sensor toggle rows.
Wrap-content heading for a Wear list.
Device-bound time label whose placement is evaluated on a large-round canvas.

library: Wear Compose Material + Home Assistant surfaces
